text:
The text contains a social engineering tactic known as **pretexting**. The attacker creates a fabricated scenario (meeting at a conference, expressing interest in work) to build rapport and establish a false sense of legitimacy. They then use a plausible excuse (potential investor interest) to justify the request for sensitive information (the project proposal preview). This is designed to lower the victim's guard and manipulate them into sharing confidential data under the guise of a professional opportunity.

The animal that says 'meow' is a cat.
